description: Unified chronological timeline of a company combining BORME registry acts and public procurement awards (PLACSP), newest first, each entry with date, category, source, source URL and confidence. The `limit` (default 30) bounds the list; the response reports `events_total`. Amounts are source-reported awards, not proof of payment.

limit.description: Most recent timeline entries to return, 1-200 (default 30). The API returns the whole timeline; this bounds it for context.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_timeline
